@Pree, I couldn't find a ticket number for the West yard Door 2 double-booking at Marrow Fieldworks. My search of the knowledge base returned nothing for that combination of terms, and I didn't find it in #central-team either.

The closest thing I found is **MFW-218**, from an April 2026 CRM note on the Marrow Fieldworks account. That ticket covers a different door mix-up: an appointment moved from door 6 to door 4 and the printed arrival sheet didn't match. It may not be the one you need, so please check it before using it. The November QBR notes also describe a Door 3 double-booking at the west yard, but they don't include a ticket number. If the Door 2 issue was logged in a support queue or a channel I can't see, the ticket number will be there.
